title: slopvac v3 terms file
description: A list of project terms: product names, acronyms and other words that rules must not flag or must spell a fixed way. The project file is .slopvac/terms.toml, and packs ship more. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/packs.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4.

Term.description: One term. Only `term` is required. The canonical spelling is `term`. A listed variant is a wrong spelling that a check may flag and fix to the canonical one.

kind.description: What the term is, as a kebab-case label. Known values: product, language, protocol, acronym, proper-noun, identifier and jargon. A check may treat acronyms and identifiers differently from prose words.

ignore_case.description: Accept any casing. The term then works as an allow-list entry and no casing finding fires for it.

case_sensitive.description: Match only the exact spelling of `term` and its variants. Other casings are different words and never flag. For names that are also common words, such as Go, Rust, React, Windows and REST: `go` in running text is not a finding. Cannot combine with ignore_case.
